title: Survive a Cache Flush
description: The database handles the normal 5% miss load but cannot handle all traffic. A deploy accidentally flushes the cache. Which protection should the design already have?

options.text: Let every miss query the database immediately.
options.explanation: The cold cache removes the offload precisely when the source has insufficient capacity.

options.text: Promise a shorter TTL will make the cache refill with less work.
options.explanation: Short TTLs do not bound concurrent source work and can cause more churn.

options.text: Add more API instances without limiting database connections.
options.explanation: More callers can overwhelm the same primary faster.

options.text: Coalesce refills, warm important keys and bound fallback traffic with a degraded mode.
options.explanation: A cache can be an availability dependency. Coordinated regeneration and admission limits keep recovery within source capacity; degradation must match the product's freshness rules.
